entities.name: Robert Miller Montague
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Miller Montague was a lieutenant general in the United States Army. He achieved prominence as the deputy commander of Fort Bliss, Texas, commander of the Sandia Missile Base in New Mexico and head of the U.S. Caribbean Command.
